about:
# Fishing Mastery

A fishing companion for **World of Warcraft: Forever**. It records every cast you make and turns
it into numbers you can trust: how often you catch, how fast, what gets away and why, and what
each water should give you at your skill. A journal lists every fish, water, recipe, and piece of
fishing gear, with what you have already caught and owned.

Published on CurseForge as **Fishing Mastery Forever**; in game it is called Fishing Mastery. Free
and open source (GPL-3.0). Developers: see the [development reference](https://github.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/blob/main/docs/development.md).

![The Statistics Overview: the Fishing skill bar, catches, success rate, catches per hour, active fishing time, where casts end, and the most caught fish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/main/docs/images/stats-overview.png)

| HUD card while fishing | Journal: every fish with where it bites |
|---|---|
| ![The HUD card in Booty Bay: 21 % get away, the skill bar with the lure mark, the lure timer, catches, success, per hour, the last catch, and the water's fish](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/main/docs/images/hud-card.png) | ![The Journal Fish tab with Raw Spotted Yellowtail selected: caught, first catch, skill, and the places it bites](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/main/docs/images/journal-fish.png) |

## Features

- **Tracking:** every cast and its outcome (catch, getaway, early click, timeout, cancel, invalid
  target), with bite time, loot, zone and subzone, skill, and lure. Your history is kept per
  character. The game writes it at logout or `/reload`, so a crash loses the casts since then; a
  reload reminder after two hours of fishing helps (`/fm reminder on|off`).
- **HUD card:** the water with its getaway risk, your skill bar, the lure with its time left or
  the one that would help, catches, success rate, catches per hour, how long the session runs and
  what its catch is worth at a vendor, the last catch, and the water's fish you have not caught
  there yet. Movable, scalable, see-through, or one compact line.
- **Session summary** after a session ends, as a card like the HUD (catches, success, per hour,
  what you caught and what was new) or in the chat.
- **One window** (left click on the minimap button) with a side tab per module, like the
  Professions window.
- **Statistics** (`/fm stats`) with eight tabs: Overview, Fish,
  Zones, Failures, Bite times, Sessions, Skill, Compare. Every rate shows a 95 % range, and small
  samples show counts only, so a lucky streak is not mistaken for a rule.
- **Journal** (`/fm journal`, Shift + left click on the minimap button):
  - **Fish:** every fish, trophy fish, container, and quest fish, caught or not, with where it
    bites, the skill it needs, the recipes that use it, its season, and your catches by month.
  - **Waters:** every water colored for your skill (or your best gear setup): red = no catch,
    orange = some fish get away, green = no getaways.
  - **Recipes:** recipes that use fish, which ones you know, and how many reagents you have. Open
    a profession window once to add the Forever recipes you know.
  - **Gear:** poles, gear, lures, buff food, fishing ranks, and the glove enchant, with what you
    own (bags, bank, equipped) and your best possible skill.
- **Helpers page** (`/fm helpers`): every helper with a check box and what it does right now.
- **Casting key:** bind a key to "Cast Fishing" on the Helpers page (or in Key Bindings, AddOns,
  Fishing Mastery) and cast without an action bar slot. It acts only when you press it.
- **Double right-click casting** (off by default): with a fishing pole in hand, a double
  right-click into the world casts Fishing.
- **Smart lure** (off by default): the casting key and the double right-click first put on the
  cheapest lure in your bags that stops getaways in this water, or your best one if none does, and
  nothing when your skill is enough. The HUD tooltip says which lure would help.
- **Louder splash** (off by default): with a pole in hand, sound effects at full volume and music
  and ambience off; your own volumes come back when you put the pole away or log out.
- **Hide the interface while fishing** (off by default): like Alt+Z when your line goes out; it
  comes back when you move, fight, get a whisper, and more. Your catches show at the top.
- **Item tooltips** show "Fishing Mastery: caught 37" and your best water for items you caught.
- **Backups:** daily snapshots, `/fm export` and `/fm import` as copyable text.

## Install

Install with the CurseForge app, or download the zip from the releases and unpack the
`FishingMastery` folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns`. Restart the game.
Your data stays when you update.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|--------------|
| `/fm` | Help: version and all commands |
| `/fm stats` | Statistics page |
| `/fm journal` | Journal page |
| `/fm summary` | Summary of the open or last session |
| `/fm status` | The current session in the chat |
| `/fm hud show`, `hide`, `lock`, `unlock`, `reset` | Show, hide, lock, or reset the HUD |
| `/fm hud scale <0.5-2>`, `/fm hud layout card` or `compact` | HUD size and layout |
| `/fm settings` | Settings page (also right click on the minimap button) |
| `/fm contribute` | Your catch counts as text to share (no names, IDs, or times) |
| `/fm helpers` | Helpers page; also prints what the helpers did since login |
| `/fm minimap show` or `hide` | The minimap button |
| `/fm export`, `/fm export all`, `/fm import` | Copy your history out, or back in |
| `/fm backup list`, `/fm backup restore <n>` | Daily snapshots of your totals and settings |
| `/fm rebuild` | Count all totals again from your history |

## Where the Numbers Come From

- **Your own catches.** Everything you see as "you" or "own" is counted from your casts.
- **Classic estimate.** The fish lists, drop chances, and base skill per water come from the
  CMaNGOS classic-db, a reconstruction of 1.12 Classic. Forever changed some waters and added new
  fish, so the addon always shows the Classic estimate next to your own numbers and marks fish
  "not in the Classic data". Seasons and day/night windows are Classic rules, marked
  "unconfirmed" until your catches show them.
- **The game client.** Item, zone, spell, and quest names, gear tooltips, and your recipes are read
  from the client, so every language works.

Full credits and licenses: [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/blob/main/FishingMastery/NOTICE.md).

## Privacy

- **All data stays on your PC**, in the addon's saved files in your `WTF` folder. The addon never
  sends anything: no chat messages, no addon messages, no network.
- The saved file holds your casts (time, place, skill, loot), your settings, and for each of your
  characters its name and character ID, so the addon can tell them apart. No other player's name,
  no chat text, no account name.
- `/fm export` shows one character's history as text **without** its name or ID; it still holds
  the time and place of every cast. `/fm export all` is a full backup **with** names and IDs:
  keep it private.
- `/fm contribute` shows your catch counts to share: per area and skill band, summed over your
  characters, with a random token (`/fm contribute new-token` makes a new one). No names,
  realms, character IDs, subzone texts, or times.
- Nothing leaves the game unless you copy it out yourself.

## Problems and Ideas

Open an issue on the project's GitHub page. Please add your client language, what you did, and
any Lua error text (`/console scriptErrors 1` shows Lua errors). `/fm` lists the last addon errors.

## License

GPL-3.0, see [LICENSE](https://github.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/blob/main/LICENSE). Bundled data: CMaNGOS classic-db (GPL-3.0) and the AllTheThings
Forever client exports (MIT), see [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/dingelheimer/fishing-mastery/blob/main/FishingMastery/NOTICE.md). World of Warcraft is a
trademark of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.; this addon is not made or endorsed by Blizzard.

# Changelog

## 1.1.1

Polish of the 1.1.0 interface, closer to the drafts it was built from. Your saved data and
settings carry over.

- Changed: bars in the Statistics pages use the softer colors of the drafts with a slight
  gradient; getaway charts are orange.
- Changed: the active fishing time reads "4 h 44 min" with small units, and the notes under the
  Overview's lower panels sit right below their rows. The HUD card shows "%" small next to the
  success number, thin lines between its parts, and a green tick on the skill bar where getaways
  stop.
- Changed: the HUD names the running lure ("Shiny Bauble +25" with its icon). In water where fish
  get away its tooltip always shows the best lure in your bags, marked "on the pole" when it is
  the one running. The tooltip's labels are shorter ("Success", "Per hour").
- Changed: the window's panels have a dark warm brown tint, as in the drafts; "Panels: game" in
  the Settings page header brings back the grey of the game's windows.
- New: the HUD background setting "Solid" puts a dark, non-see-through background behind the HUD
  (default: the game's see-through tooltip look).
- New: the HUD card shows how long the session has been running and the vendor value of what you
  caught in it; the compact line ends with the session time.
- Changed: the session summary is a card like the HUD: the water and active time, your skill
  change, catches, success, and catches per hour, the outcomes, the vendor value, the fish you
  caught (new ones marked), and how the session compares with your average there. The chat style
  is unchanged.

## 1.1.0

The interface overhaul: one Fishing Mastery window with side tabs for Statistics, Journal,
Helpers, and Settings, a HUD card, and every table and tooltip in the game's style. Your saved
data, settings, and history carry over.

- Fixed: an open HUD tooltip kept the numbers of the moment you hovered; it now follows the card
  while it is open.
- Changed: every tooltip of the addon uses short labels and values in the game's style. The item
  tooltip shows "Fishing Mastery" with "caught N" and your best water; the minimap button shows
  the session, your Fishing skill, and the click hints; chart bars and calendar days list their
  numbers as pairs. Longer explanations (settings, helpers, comparisons) appear while Shift is
  held. The fish details in the Journal are label and value pairs with the places and recipes as
  small tables instead of a block of sentences.
- Fixed: in places the game reports as the continent, such as the cave outside Wailing Caverns,
  the HUD named "Kalimdor" and knew no risk or fish; new casts there were saved under Kalimdor.
  Both now use the zone shown on screen (The Barrens). Casts saved before stay as they are.
- Changed: statistics and journal are pages of one Fishing Mastery window with side tabs on its
  right edge, like the Professions window. It opens on the last page, moves by the title, and
  closes with Escape. Window positions saved before this version are reset once.
- Changed: the HUD is a card in the tooltip look: the water with a risk tag, the skill bar with a
  mark at your skill with lure and gear, the lure with a timer or the one that would help, three
  headline numbers, the last catch, and the water's fish as icons. Its tooltip lists short labels
  and values with the explanations behind Shift. The compact layout is one line. Two buttons on
  the HUD switch between card and compact and stop the session now.
- New: a Settings page in the window with every setting grouped, a live HUD preview, the data
  buttons, and Defaults. New HUD settings: layout (card or compact; your old style carries over)
  and opacity. The game's Options entry now opens this page. `/fm hud style` is now
  `/fm hud layout card|compact`.
- New: a Helpers page in the window. Turn each helper on or off, see whether it is ready or
  what blocks it, bind the casting key in place, see what the smart lure would do in this water,
  and this login's counts. The helpers left the game's settings panel; your settings are kept.
- Changed: the Journal tabs show item icons and quality colors, season and night tags, a
  progress bar in the page header (every group in its tooltip), dropdown-styled filters, and
  recipe and gear tooltips as short labels and values.
- Changed: the Fish tab has six columns with item icons, quality colors, and season or night
  tags; the hour and dates moved into the row tooltip. Every table's row tooltip lists short
  labels and values with the range in grey brackets; explanations appear while Shift is held.
- Changed: the Statistics Overview shows your Fishing skill bar, four headline numbers with their
  likely range, where your casts end, and your five most caught items, for this character or all
  characters. The records and the fishing days calendar moved to the Sessions tab.
- Changed: tables have a gold header bar with a sort arrow on the sorted column, striped rows,
  and a highlight on the row under the mouse (first step of the interface overhaul).
- New: `/fm contribute` shows your catch counts per area and skill band to share, with a random
  token and no names, IDs, or times.

## 1.0.0

First stable release: the tracker, statistics, zones, and journal of the beta, plus the helpers.
Every helper is off by default, and the casting key has no key until you set one.

- New: casting key. Bind a key to "Cast Fishing" (Key Bindings, AddOns, Fishing Mastery); the
  settings panel has a Helpers section that says where.
- New: double right-click casting (setting "Double right-click casts Fishing", off by default).
  With a fishing pole in hand, a double right-click into the world casts Fishing; right-clicks on
  units and windows, camera turning, and combat stay as they are. The setting's tooltip warns when
  Luredon or Classic Fishing Companion is loaded.
- New: smart lure (setting "Apply a lure first", off by default). The casting key and the double
  right-click put on the cheapest lure in your bags that stops getaways in this water (your best
  one if none does), and none when your skill is enough or a lure is running. The HUD tooltip names
  the lure that would help, with the setting on or off.
- New: louder splash (setting, off by default): sound effects at full volume, music and ambience
  off while a fishing pole is equipped; your own volumes are restored afterwards and at logout.
- New: hide the interface while fishing (setting, off by default), like Alt+Z when the line goes
  out; it comes back on movement, combat, death, a target change, a whisper, a dialog, a loot
  window without auto loot, or when the pole leaves your hand. Catches show at the top of the
  screen while it is hidden.
- New: `/fm helpers` shows what the helpers did since login and their settings.
- Changed: the version in `/fm` no longer shows the tag's leading "v" ("1.0.0").
- Fixed: the Recipes tab listed cooking recipes with raw meat or eggs as recipes that use fish.
  A Forever item now counts as a fish only once it was caught while fishing.

## 0.9.0-beta

First public test release for World of Warcraft: Forever.

### Tracking

- Records every fishing cast and its outcome: catch, getaway, early click, timeout, cancel,
  invalid target. Catches keep the bite time, the loot, and the place (zone and subzone).
- History is stored per character in compact day chunks, with daily snapshots of the totals,
  `/fm rebuild`, and a quarantine for damaged parts instead of deleting them.
- `/fm export` (no names or IDs) and `/fm export all` (full backup) as copyable text pages;
  `/fm import` adds missing days.
